T1.name: T1_goal_test_the_missing_interaction_before_relocating
T1.description: #238 showed BAM's Bell chain needs exactly one undelivered thing: an operation or observable at a mouth coherently connecting distinct winding sectors. The obvious next move is to relocate the chain onto the transported-frame / spin doublet, where the qubit is not the winding charge. Before doing that the missing interaction should be tested DIRECTLY -- does a minimal winding-mixing term exist, does it restore the violation, and what does it cost? Assuming it cannot be had would repeat the error #233 made about the one-throat ring.

T2.name: T2_only_the_second_chi_harmonic_connects_the_qubit
T2.description: Among mouth-localized fiber-angle potentials cos(2 pi m chi / N_chi + phi), only m = 2 connects the qubit at first order: |<+1|V|-1>| = 0.4082 for m = 2, and exactly zero for m = 1, 3 and 4. The reason is elementary and worth stating: the qubit is k = +/-1, so the coupling must carry Delta k = 2, and the m-th harmonic carries Delta k = m. *** So the minimal missing interaction is uniquely identified: the SECOND chi-harmonic at a mouth -- physically, a fiber-angle anisotropy of the mouth, i.e. a mouth that is not round in the fiber direction. ***

T3.name: T3_the_term_is_exactly_pure_sigma_x_on_the_qubit
T3.description: Restricted to the qubit the second harmonic is PURE sigma_x with coefficient 0.408248 -- the coefficients on I, sigma_y and sigma_z are all zero to 1e-16. *** That is precisely the non-abelian generator #238 found to be missing: it does not commute with the derived sigma_z detector (||[V, sigma_z]|| = 0.8165), so conjugating that detector by settings it generates sweeps the x-z circle instead of standing still. The gap #238 identified is therefore fillable, and by one specific term rather than by an open-ended search. ***

T4.name: T4_the_derived_detector_now_violates
T4.description: With the DERIVED sigma_z winding Stern-Gerlach as the detector -- unchanged from #238, no transverse readout assumed -- and settings generated by the second harmonic, the maximum CHSH on the committed #206 singlet is 2.828427, against 2.000000 with no mixing term at all. *** So the minimal interaction does the whole job: it converts #238's abelian span{I, sigma_z} into a non-abelian algebra and recovers essentially Tsirelson. The question is no longer whether the gap can be filled but what filling it costs. ***

T5.name: T5_the_minimal_term_breaks_winding_charge_conservation
T5.description: Winding IS charge in this program (#42-#44, the KK gauge coupling), and the committed dynamics conserves it exactly: ||[H, K]|| = 6.6e-16 with the handle cut. The minimal mixing term does not: ||[V_2, K]|| = 1.414, and the combined generator gives 1.414. *** So the interaction that rescues the Bell chain on the winding carrier is a CHARGE-NON-CONSERVING mouth term. This is not a technicality to be absorbed later: charge conservation is a committed structural result of the program, and the fiber-angle anisotropy that supplies the missing generator is exactly what breaks the fiber U(1) that protects it. The two cannot both hold at the same mouth. ***

T6.name: T6_leakage_leaves_only_a_narrow_loophole_free_window
T6.description: The same term drives population out of the encoded k = +/-1 sector (into k = +/-3), so the settings that rotate the detector also deplete the qubit. Treating that leakage conservatively as detection inefficiency and applying the standard CHSH bound S > 4/eta - 2: the margin is POSITIVE only for small setting spans, peaking at |t| = 0.4 with S = 2.134938, eta = 0.9704 and margin +0.012973. *** A loophole-free window exists -- so this is not a no-go -- but it is narrow, and TSIRELSON SATURATION IS NOT IN IT: at the span that reaches S = 2.828 the retention has fallen to 0.4697 and the threshold is 6.52. *** HONEST CAVEAT: the leaked population sits in other winding channels and is in principle detectable there, so reading it as pure inefficiency is the conservative choice, not the only one; a detector that resolved k = +/-3 would recover some of it, and that is untested here.

T7.name: T7_consequences_for_the_relocation_decision
T7.description: The probe was run to avoid assuming the missing interaction away, and it was right not to: the interaction exists and works. But the two costs are structural rather than incidental. Charge non-conservation is the sharper one, because the fiber U(1) that protects winding is exactly the symmetry the mixing term must break -- the same generator cannot both conserve charge and rotate the qubit. That is a clean argument for moving the chain to a carrier whose qubit is not the charge, which is what the transported-frame / spin doublet (#192/#197) offers, and it is now an argument with numbers rather than a preference.

items.status: NO -- the missing generator exists, is unique at first order (the second chi-harmonic), and restores CHSH to 2.83 with the derived detector. Testing it beat assuming it away.

items.claim: the Bell chain can stay on the winding carrier
items.status: ONLY AT THE PRICE OF CHARGE -- the term that supplies the generator breaks the fiber U(1), and winding is charge (#42-#44). ||[V_2, K]|| = 1.414 against the committed dynamics' 6.6e-16.

items.claim: granting the term, the violation is as strong as the formalism allows
items.status: NO -- loophole-free only up to S ~ 2.13 (eta = 0.970); Tsirelson saturation needs eta = 0.470, far below the detection threshold.

items.claim: relocate the Bell chain to the spin doublet
items.status: RECOMMENDED, AND NOW QUANTITATIVELY -- on the winding carrier the price is a conservation law and the payoff is a margin of +0.013. The spin doublet is worth trying because its qubit is not the charge, so no fiber-U(1) breaking is needed to rotate it.

T8.name: T8_assessment
T8.description: The minimal missing interaction is the second chi-harmonic at a mouth. It is unique at first order, it is exactly pure sigma_x on the qubit, and it restores CHSH from 2.000000 to 2.828427 with the derived detector -- so #238's gap is fillable. But it breaks winding-charge conservation outright, and its leakage leaves only a narrow loophole-free window topping out near S = 2.13. The winding carrier can host the Bell chain only by giving up a conservation law.
established: the minimal winding-mixing term is UNIQUE at first order: only the second chi-harmonic connects k = +1 to k = -1 (|<+1|V|-1>| = 0.4082; m = 1, 3, 4 give exactly zero)
restricted to the qubit it is PURE sigma_x, coefficient 0.408248, with I / sigma_y / sigma_z coefficients zero to 1e-16 -- exactly the generator #238 found missing
with the DERIVED sigma_z winding detector it restores CHSH from 2.000000 to 2.828427 (Tsirelson)
it breaks winding = charge conservation: ||[V_2, K]|| = 1.414 against the committed 6.6e-16
its leakage leaves a loophole-free window only for small setting spans, best margin +0.013 at S = 2.135, eta = 0.970; Tsirelson saturation needs eta = 0.470 and is NOT loophole-free
open: whether a detector resolving k = +/-3 recovers the leaked population and widens the window -- the leakage is treated conservatively as inefficiency here, which is a choice
whether the transported-frame / spin doublet (#192/#197) supplies a rotation generator without breaking any conservation law -- the relocation this probe was run to inform, still untested
whether any BAM geometry realizes a fiber-anisotropic mouth, and what else that would break besides charge
the multipartite chain (#207/#208) under the same term
